ns2:section.sectionText: Field expedition to Costa Rica over spring break (approx. 9 days), and weekly seminar. The course will use Costa Rica as a case study to examine environment and sustainability issues. Coverage includes: rainforest ecology, land-use issues, sustainable agriculture, developing economies, and geologic features of the landscape (e.g., volcanoes; rivers). Restricted to ESE majors; non-ESE majors in LAS can apply to the waitlist (email tomkin@illinois.edu). LAS Students will be responsible for the field trip expenses in the amount of $1700 (this reduced fee includes an LAS study abroad Scholarship).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Earth Systems, Env, & Society or Earth, Society, & Environment major(s).
